_meta.tests_excluded_reason: pytest discovers test_*.py by name convention; nothing references them, so absence of a caller carries no information about them
_meta.candidate_note: DOC-ONLY and UNREFERENCED are CANDIDATES FOR TRIAGE, not deletions. Unwired means SUPERSEDED (retire) or ORPHANED (revive) and only reading the code tells you which.
_meta.ambiguity_note: A module stem shared by two files credits both. Deliberate: over-crediting hides a revival candidate, under-crediting invites deleting a live tool.
